_readme: Central asset manifest. Every image, video still, artifact, logo-adjacent card, and metric marker on the site resolves through this file.

To replace a placeholder: drop the file into src/assets/<file> (images) or public/media/<file> (video), then set `file` (and `poster` for video) on the matching entry. No layout code changes are required.
`permission` must be one of: pending | approved | redacted | private-only. Only `approved` entries with a real file render on the public site.
Entries without an approved file render nothing in a production build. Labeled placeholders appear in `npm run dev` only, so the public site never shows a placeholder card.
Aspect ratios are strings like 16:9. A real file is cropped to it with object-fit: cover.

assets.label: Bolt in 60 Seconds
assets.alt: Bolt in 60 Seconds, the one-minute animated explanation of Bolt Liquidity, with music, voiceover and sound effects.
assets.source: bolt-in-60-seconds.mp4 from the Portfolio folder (60.0 s, 1920x1080 at 23.976 fps, H.264 with AAC stereo audio, 16.4 MB), the approved optimized film; it stays outside the repository under its own name. The full film, uncut: no trim, no re-grade and no change to the music, voiceover and sound-effects mix. Wide screens get a lossless remux of it (the same video and audio streams, bit for bit, with the editing application's metadata removed and the index moved to the front so playback starts while it downloads); phones (fileSmall) get a 1280x720 H.264 encode of the same picture with the audio stream copied unchanged. Poster: hero-thumbnail.png from the Portfolio folder, the film's own thumbnail. Narration check (V1.2): every spoken line appears on screen as type or as a labeled diagram (the price, contract and settlement steps, and trades 1 to 3 drawing on one pool), so no caption track ships; see the README.
assets.credit: Animation and visual production: Bob van der Meer.
